name: calendar-register
description: Register a Nylas calendar in the contact registry, linking it to a contact. Use this after calendar-list-calendars identifies an unregistered calendar and the principal confirms which contact it belongs to. Always requires an explicit contact_id — ask the principal who owns the calendar if unsure.

inputs.label: string
inputs.mailbox: string? (mailbox id it is read through; required when several are connected, unless the ID is a mailbox's own address)
